SELECT a.StationID AS stationId, (SELECT stationname FROM dbtoms.stationcode WHERE a.StationID = stationid LIMIT 1 ) AS stationName, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DealStatus&14=6 THEN CarNum ELSE 0 END),0) as officialIcCardCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DealStatus&14=8 THEN CarNum ELSE 0 END),0) as militaryIcCardCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DealStatus&14=12 THEN CarNum ELSE 0 END),0) as freeIcCardCount, IFNULL(SUM(TotalToll / 100), 0) as statAmount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN (DealStatus&14!=14 AND DealStatus&14!=2 AND DealStatus&0xE00000!=0x200000 AND DealStatus&0x1000000=0 AND DealStatus&32!=32 AND CardType=0) OR (CardType=26 AND DealStatus&32!=32) THEN CardNum ELSE 0 END),0) as dueIcCardCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DealStatus&14=4 THEN TotalArrearage ELSE 0 END),0)/100 arrearsAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.PayType = 0 THEN a.TotalToll / 100 ELSE 0 END) AS dueAmount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DealStatus&14=4 THEN CarNum ELSE 0 END),0) arrearsTrips, IFNULL(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN PayType=16 THEN TotalToll ELSE 0 END)/100 as DECIMAL(10,2)), 0) mobilePaymentAmount, IFNULL(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN PayType=2 THEN TotalToll ELSE 0 END) /100 as DECIMAL(10,2)), 0) as ePaymentAmount, LEFT(a.StaDate, 6) AS monthDate, a.StaDate AS staDate FROM
SELECT * FROM ${tableName} AS alias${index + 1}
AND StationID in
#{stationId}
AND StaDate >= #{intBeginTime}
AND StaDate <= #{intEndTime}
AND CancelFlag = 0 AND RecordType &1 =1
a
GROUP BY StaDate
GROUP BY monthDate
GROUP BY StationID
ORDER BY StaDate ASC
ORDER BY monthDate ASC
ORDER BY StationID ASC

SELECT * FROM ${tableName} AS alias${index + 1}
AND StationID in

AND StaDate >= #{intBeginTime}

a

GROUP BY monthDate
GROUP BY StationID

ORDER BY StaDate ASC
ORDER BY monthDate ASC
ORDER BY StationID ASC
ORDER BY OperatorID ASC
